call_points.text: NIM improved to 8.2% in Q2FY27 from 5.9% in the year-ago quarter.
Steady-state credit cost of 2% expected by FY28 after clearing provisioning backlogs.

Kerala accounts for 71% of the deposit mix and 33% of gross advances.
